# Location State

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LocationState`](gmeow-LocationState.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LocationState>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The state of a moving entity at a specific point or period in time, including its location, velocity, and pose (position + orientation).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)
